It is a .NET/C#-based IDE and debugging tool specializing in retro game development for the Commodore C64 (and VIC20). Main features from the repository README/About: an integrated development environment with source-code editing for 6502 assembly and C#, an assembler/compiler toolchain, emulators for C64/VIC20 to run and test programs, a full debugger with breakpoints, memory/IO inspection and trace capabilities, disk/tape image handling (D64/TAP), sprite and character-set editors for graphics work, and cross-platform support including Linux via Wine/PlayOnLinux.
